grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing your Guardian's Allowance claim

grants.description: Check your Child Benefit records to verify eligibility for Guardian's Allowance
grants.purpose: Guardian's Allowance requires that you qualify for Child Benefit for the child

grants.description: Share details about the child you are claiming Guardian's Allowance for
grants.purpose: To identify the child and verify your guardianship arrangement

grants.description: Share details about the child's deceased parent(s) or surviving parent circumstances
grants.purpose: To verify that the child's parents have died or meet the special circumstances for one surviving parent

grants.description: Upload the child's birth certificate and parent death certificates
grants.purpose: HMRC requires original or certified copies of these documents to process your claim

grants.description: Provide your bank account details for Guardian's Allowance payments
grants.purpose: Guardian's Allowance will be paid into this account, usually every 4 weeks alongside Child Benefit

grants.description: Verify the deceased parent(s) connection to the UK
grants.purpose: At least one parent must have been born in UK/EEA/Switzerland or lived in UK since age 16 for 52 weeks in any 2-year period

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Guardian's Allowance Unit by phone or post, or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Your Guardian's Allowance claim will be cancelled and payments will stop. You may lose backdated payments if you revoke before a decision is made.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide bank details on your behalf without explicit confirmation. Agent cannot make false declarations about parent deaths or whereabouts. Agent cannot upload documents without your explicit approval of each document. Agent must route to human assistance for complex surviving parent situations (prison, hospital order, untraceable).
